name: seo-foundation
summary: Prepare the canonical SEO evidence, approval, mode, and handoff contract before mode-specific work.
inputs: SEO mode and scoped client/site/artifact context
approved evidence or local tool target
writes: scoped foundation, gate, plan, or evidence artifact
external_reads: approved live pages, crawls, providers, or first-party sources
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live URLs, crawls, providers, or credentialed sources
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context and approved evidence paths
external_mutation: CMS, code, analytics, provider, SEO, and production mutation is out of scope
done_when: mode, scope, sources, labels, approvals, limitations, and handoffs are explicit
missing, partial, capped, stale, blocked, or unavailable evidence is visible
no unsupported performance or visibility guarantee is made
verification: verify no unapproved external mutation occurred
